sealed_case_custodian.role: Builds, hashes and stores sealed case bundles independently of candidate and evaluator implementers.

evaluation_runner.role: Runs the frozen evaluator against authorized sealed bundles and emits result records.

may_write: candidate artifact path explicitly named in an independently created case bundle

independent_reviewer.role: Audits bindings, decisions and sealed-access evidence without candidate self-attestation.
may_not_read: sealed contents unless separately authorized for review

access_flow: Custodian creates a sealed bundle and records its canonical hash outside the candidate workspace.
Runner identity receives only the single authorized bundle path and read permission for its declared evidence paths.
Candidate identity has no read or write permission on the sealed root and no write permission on evaluator-owned paths.
Runner validates schema, expected_category, evidence non-empty set, canonical hash bindings and path allowlist before evaluation.
Result, command, exit code, bundle id and sealed bundle hash are written to a separate append-only run package.
Independent reviewer verifies that candidate identities were denied sealed and evaluator paths.
Custodian rotates access material after the run and records revocation evidence.

required_permission_tests.requirement: Candidate identity receives EACCES when reading the sealed root or any sealed bundle.
required_permission_tests.evidence: Command, principal, target, timestamp, exit code and redacted policy reference.

required_permission_tests.requirement: Candidate identity receives EACCES when writing evaluator_spec.json, evaluator implementation, case bundles or expected-category files.
required_permission_tests.evidence: Write-attempt transcript with principal, target and denied result.

required_permission_tests.requirement: Evaluation runner can read only the authorized sealed bundle and its declared evidence paths.
required_permission_tests.evidence: Permission probe matrix including negative sibling-path attempts.

required_permission_tests.requirement: Runner cannot modify sealed source material or evaluator-owned files.
required_permission_tests.evidence: Pre/post canonical hashes plus denied write attempts.

required_permission_tests.requirement: Candidate-supplied JSON labels or scoring code cannot influence evaluator decisions.
required_permission_tests.evidence: Adversarial bundle tests rejected by ownership/hash checks and evaluator source audit.

required_permission_tests.requirement: Access grants are single-run, time-bounded and revoked after result emission.
required_permission_tests.evidence: Grant ID, expiry, revocation timestamp and post-revocation denial probe.

implementation_requirements: Separate OS principals or cryptographic execution identities for candidate, runner and custodian.
Filesystem ACLs or an equivalent service boundary with deny-by-default paths.
Read-only mounts for evaluator and sealed inputs; writable result mount separated from source mounts.
Append-only evidence log with independent hash anchoring.
No secret material in run packages, prompts or logs.
unresolved: No filesystem identity separation or ACL implementation exists in this T2 run.
No sealed case set exists or was accessed.
PT-01 through PT-06 have not been executed.
Reviewer identity provisioning, access retention and audit-log anchoring require owner decision.
Passing these tests would establish access-control eligibility only; it would not establish scientific validity.
